title: suck_pull format_nntp_date hand-rolls Gregorian calendar arithmetic
description: In crates/transit/src/import/suck_pull.rs, format_nntp_date implements its own Gregorian calendar decomposition (400/100/4/1 year cycles). This is subtle code with edge cases. The chrono crate is already in the dependency graph; replace with chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp(secs, 0).format("...").
